title: Game heavily freezes and lags when adding characters
author: No-Ear7072
selftext: I recently created a game and I tried to add characters. I created them with tripo and added skeleton with mixamo. Since then my game lags like crazy. This didnt happen when I had so many assets and texture. What is going on?

comments.author: ResenhaDoBar
comments.body: Better to ask your AI, it’s impossible for any of us to know what’s going on within your project

replies.author: No-Ear7072
replies.body: I have been asking it and he cant figure it out. Btw do u recommend getting advanced gaming pc to build games?

replies.author: Old-Moment-5297
replies.body: What is the objective of building your games? just for you?

replies.author: No-Ear7072
replies.body: Ideally For everyone so I understand that even people with low quality graphs should be able to play

replies.author: Varrianda
replies.body: Ask it to instrument debug logs during the load in phase with start/end times, then run the game and feed the logs into Claude after the freeze.

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
what is poly count for your tripo characters? if you have many characters in 15-18k poly count, it is going to lag. even by tripo's own definition, game asset should be 3000-5000 at most 

you need a way to optimize the character models.

replies.author: samuele_v
replies.body: 15k poly per character is absolutely fine, but most generators (Meshy, Rodin, I haven't tried Tripo but I have no reason to think it's any different) by default create models with more than 1 MILLION poly and 4k textures (which is overkill). A few of these and a project could definitely lag.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
18k is like tripo's medium quality export. I use it here and there but I keep the spawn count low

15k poly per character can lag for lower spec PC I think if OP is making tower defense or survivor clones (i assume its PC since mobile would lag for sure)

replies.author: samuele_v
replies.body:
Yeah it would definitely depend on specs and game type, if he using 15k for each audience member in a football game it's going to be problematic 😆.

But I have a medium-ish hardware and have no issues with around 10 and more characters at around 30-40k poly each in a 3D world with VFX, combat etc. so I still think something else is probably the culprit.

Unless of course he is coding on a laptop and testing on an old phone.

comments.author: tomato-shadow
comments.body:
Why don't you try asking AI?

Seriously though, don't expect to take shortcuts and have everything run smoothly. If you don't know what you're doing, things aren't going to work like you wish they would.

Nobody's going to have an answer for you because it could be just about anything and we have no information about your project or what you're doing.

In good faith, I would hypothesise that whatever you used to generate your character made a mesh that isn't game ready and has too many polygons. If you have any control over that, I would suggest trying to adjust it.

comments.author: LusikkaFeed
comments.body: Polycount. Please learn even the minimum amount before vibecoding some subpar shit.

replies.author: puddlethefish
replies.body:
the irony is that you’re probably wrong, you do realize how many polys modern games push, right? he is not blowing through that budget with a few characters

why bother with such an inflammatory post anyway?

replies.author: LusikkaFeed
replies.body: Because the polycounts on AI generated assets are fucking horrible. And he said it's after adding them. Oh and also I have tried adding AI generated assets to a prototype and it plummeted the performance.

replies.author: derAres
replies.body: Agree. I have a strong gpu and it had to WORK when I user a hand full of genrated models with terribly high polycount.

replies.author: puddlethefish
replies.body:
sure, I mean they are all voxel based methods right now and they’re converted into polys, but that doesn’t necessarily mean they’re going to be egregiously high poly compared to AAA games which punt out like 200k poly characters all the time

either way the presentation of your idea was obviously pointlessly inflammatory but whatever maybe you’ll understand when you read it back 14 days later now

replies.body: My poly count is low AI thinks it might be movement matrice calculations as my computer is thrash. I genereated many asssets on tripo and it was working just fine until characters. Learn to read before posting on reddit

replies.body: Calculations are fast. But go on, generate more assets without retopo and see what happens.

replies.body:
Yeah. This comes down to the tech being used. What engine? What is the format of the models?

18K isn't tiny. But, a well-optimized loader that requires a well-optimized format should be able to handle it it up no problem.
